_what: One web search per Subjects row whose catalog gives its code no heading (Sam, 2026-11-21, on #3655: "I would add the web search any time it's not in the catalog and you are forced to make a recommendation based on a combo of data"). A session ran each search and recorded the query, the date, and the result it used. title is the subject title a page on the college's own site gives; a result on any other site records none. where says catalog (the college's catalog: the row's page is then read), college site, or none. A program or department label that does not name the subject is kept under label with title null, and is read as weaker evidence (Sam, 2026-11-21, in session: "Dept labels can be helpful for our edge case recommendations"). kb/_build_local_subject_recommendations.py reads this file: a search that agrees with another source lifts its level one step, one that differs is shown beside it, and a search by itself is never more than Low.
